err_missing_package_files_desc: Ka firmware package ka duna ia ka file scatter lane ki file dur ba donkam. Sngewbha download biang ia ka package lane jied ia ka firmware file ba pura.
err_auth_file_unusable_title: Ka jingpynshisha ia ka file bym lah ban pyndonkam

1. Pynmeh ia ka player jong phi da kaba bat ia u Power button.
2. Haba ka Rockbox ka boot, pyndait ia u USB cable ha ka computer jong phi.
3. Lada la bthah ha ka player screen, pynthikna ia ka USB Storage mode khnang ba ka tiar kan paw kum ka drive.

themepack_step2_desc: Namar ba ki operating system (kum ka macOS) ki buhrieh ia ki dotfiles (kum ka .rockbox) da ka default, phi lah ban jied ia kano kano ka folder lane ka drive root ha ka player jong phi. Ngin sa wad hi dalade lane shna ia ka .rockbox directory na ka bynta jong phi.
